question: Are people without an affinity completely unable to use magic? Or is it more a problem of being suitable or not?
answer: People without any affinity whatsoever are fairly rare, so for the most part, those who make an effort will be able to use it. Of course, there are individual differences between the limits that will be reached. People without any affinity will be unable to use magic. Think of it as being less likely than people who get a useful blessing. Even Subaru can use magic, after all.
